$comment: CSS drift allowlist. One entry per duplicate declaration group or unreferenced class. Every entry needs a reason; add a phase when cleanup is planned. Remove the entry in the commit that resolves it. The guards fail on stale entries.

duplicateGroups.declarations: outline-offset: 2px; outline: 2px solid var(--sys-border-focus)
duplicateGroups.reason: Shared focus-ring recipe; selectors differ by component.

duplicateGroups.declarations: cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none
duplicateGroups.reason: Shared disabled-control recipe for buttons and segments.

duplicateGroups.declarations: background-color: var(--sys-color-action-primary); border-color: var(--sys-color-action-primary); color: var(--sys-text-on-action)
duplicateGroups.reason: The solid action fill is shared by the primary button and the selected solid segment.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-text-primary)
duplicateGroups.reason: Coincidental primary text colour; the link hover, the close control and the utility are independent.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: center; display: inline-flex; gap: var(--space-1)
duplicateGroups.reason: Coincidental inline-control row; the probe toggle and the theme switch are independent.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-text-secondary)
duplicateGroups.reason: Seeded controls, finding messages, panel facts and the secondary-text utility share the secondary-text colour.

duplicateGroups.declarations: border-color: var(--sys-border-focus); box-shadow: var(--sys-shadow-focus); outline: none
duplicateGroups.reason: Shared form focus recipe.

duplicateGroups.declarations: cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none
duplicateGroups.reason: Shared disabled-control recipe.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-color-info-text)
duplicateGroups.reason: Both information surfaces print the info text colour.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-1)
duplicateGroups.reason: Two wrapping inline rows that share one alignment.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: center; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-2)
duplicateGroups.reason: Wrapping action rows on independent surfaces.

duplicateGroups.declarations: transform: rotate(90deg)
duplicateGroups.reason: Two open-state chevrons rotate with the same transform.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: center; display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); justify-content: space-between
duplicateGroups.reason: A label/action split row repeated by two independent surfaces.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: center; display: flex; gap: var(--space-2)
duplicateGroups.reason: Coincidental inline group; header actions and footer status are unrelated.

duplicateGroups.declarations: display: none
duplicateGroups.reason: Coincidental hidden rendering: the Alpine cloak and the native disclosure marker are unrelated.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-text-primary); font-size: var(--text-lg); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold); margin: var(--space-0)
duplicateGroups.reason: Coincidental section-title recipe; card and page headings are independent.

duplicateGroups.declarations: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-1)
duplicateGroups.reason: Two tight vertical stacks; the card header and a summary item are independent.

duplicateGroups.declarations: cursor: pointer
duplicateGroups.reason: Two independent clickable rows share the pointer cursor.

duplicateGroups.declarations: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-2)
duplicateGroups.reason: Small vertical stacks in three unrelated cards.

duplicateGroups.declarations: background-color: var(--sys-surface-hover)
duplicateGroups.reason: Shared hover surface recipe for interactive rows and the landing menu.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-color-warning-text)
duplicateGroups.reason: The warning label, the severity utility class and the text-warning utility share the warning colour.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-color-danger-text)
duplicateGroups.reason: The error label, the severity utility class and the text-danger utility share the danger colour.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: baseline; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-2)
duplicateGroups.reason: Coincidental wrap row; the attenuation figures and a map row are unrelated.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-text-muted)
duplicateGroups.reason: The severity note and the muted-text utility share the muted colour.

duplicateGroups.declarations: display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; gap: var(--space-6); min-height: 0
duplicateGroups.reason: Top-level view shell contract: each fills the app content and owns one scroll region.

duplicateGroups.declarations: background-color: var(--sys-surface-elevated); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); border: 1px solid var(--sys-border-subtle); box-shadow: var(--sys-shadow-xl); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4); max-width: var(--container-modal-dialog); padding: var(--space-6); width: 100%
duplicateGroups.reason: The confirmation sheet reuses the dialog surface; both are overlays.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: center; display: flex; gap: var(--space-4)
duplicateGroups.reason: The workspace header halves and other header rows share one row recipe.

duplicateGroups.declarations: margin-left: auto
duplicateGroups.reason: Three controls push themselves to the end of their row.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-text-primary); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold)
duplicateGroups.reason: Coincidental emphasis text; the drawer title and a panel cell value are independent.

duplicateGroups.declarations: display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3)
duplicateGroups.reason: Two independent vertical stacks that happen to share the same rhythm.

duplicateGroups.declarations: color: var(--sys-text-muted); flex: 1; font-size: var(--text-xs); min-width: 0
duplicateGroups.reason: Both are one-line muted captions that truncate; they sit in the same header/list pattern.

duplicateGroups.declarations: align-items: center; display: flex; gap: var(--space-3)
duplicateGroups.reason: Two independent single-line headers that share the row rhythm.

duplicateGroups.declarations: margin-right: auto
duplicateGroups.reason: Label text pads its trailing unit and reset controls to the right edge.
